lemmas.primary_translation: at one's own expense / on one's own responsibility

examples.no: jeg kjøpte bilen for egen regning
examples.en: I bought the car at my own expense

definitions.text: som en selv får ta ansvaret for
definitions.translation: for which one must take responsibility oneself

examples.no: nå snakker jeg for egen regning
examples.en: now I am speaking only for myself

examples.no: den uttalelsen får stå for hans egen regning
examples.en: he alone must take responsibility for that statement
